description: West Valley Women Veterans is a community where women who served in the U.S. military find connection, belonging, and opportunities to continue making an impact. Through shared experiences, volunteer service, leadership, civic engagement, advocacy, and community partnerships, we empower women veterans to build lasting relationships, strengthen their communities, and amplify the voices and experiences of women who have served. Women veterans of all branches, eras, and backgrounds are welcome.

USA Turf Guy is a veteran-owned artificial turf company serving the Greater Phoenix area. We specialize in premium American-made artificial turf for residential and commercial properties, including pet turf, putting greens, playgrounds, and custom landscape solutions. We provide free estimates, no minimum project size, and back every installation with a 15-year warranty. Ask about discounts for veterans, first responders, teachers, and healthcare workers.
